subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Around the clock

options.text: Something that goes on day and night
Something that is done within one hour
Something that is done at night

solution: The correct answer is **Option 1)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"around the clock"** means something that continues without stopping; it goes on day and night. (दिन-रात लगातार कुछ होना) • **Example: **The hospital provides around the clock care for its patients. • **"Something that goes on day and night"** refers to any activity or event that continues without interruption throughout the day and night. (दिन-रात लगातार कुछ होना) • **Example: **The team worked** around the clock **to meet the project deadline. • Hence, we can infer that the correct meaning of "around the clock" is "something that goes on day and night". Therefore, the correct answer is: **Something that goes on day and night.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: Something that is done within one hour** (एक घंटे के भीतर किया जाने वाला कुछ) • **Example:** The task was completed within one hour, showing their efficiency. • **Option 3: Something that is time bound** (समय सीमा में बंधा हुआ कुछ) • **Example: **The assignment is time bound, and must be submitted by Friday. • **Option 4: Something that is done at night** (रात में किया जाने वाला कुछ) • **Example:** The security guard's duty is something that is done at night. 47:Tb7e, The correct answer is **Option 2****)**
